subject: Request: Permanent deletion of prompt/output logs for CustomerSupportAssistant
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@omniventure.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@omniventure.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permanent erase of prompt/output logs for CustomerSupportAssistant

Hi Marcus,

We need Redwood to permanently delete all prompt and model-output logs for our CustomerSupportAssistant project that were generated in EU region (eu-west-1) between 2026-11-01 and 2027-04-30. This includes:
- raw prompt text stored in prompt-log tables
- model response outputs (assistant answers) and derived embeddings tied to that project
- any ephemeral cache/KV entries and diagnostic traces referencing user ids for OmniVenture

Per section 7.2 of our contract, OmniVenture is requesting an attestation and manifest once deletion is complete. We would like:
1) A short runbook describing the workflow you will execute (preserve, verify, delete, attest).
2) Timeline (we prefer <=7 days but can accept 14 days with justification).
3) Proof: a signed certificate + a manifest CSV with object keys and an audit SHA256 hash.

Please confirm ownership and next steps. We are on a short compliance window and would appreciate expediting.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Trust & Safety
OmniVenture


From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena@omniventure.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permanent erase of prompt/output logs for CustomerSupportAssistant

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. I own this on the Redwood side and will coordinate ops + legal. High-level plan below; Laura (Ops) will own execution and Marissa (Legal) will prepare the attestation language.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- 0-24h: Preservation hold and identification of affected artifacts (we will snapshot object keys and isolate dataset).
- 24-72h: Ops runbook dry-run and scheduling (low-traffic window).
- 72h-7 days: Purge execution (delete prompt logs, outputs, cache entries).
- +1 day after purge: Deliver artifacts: signed purge_certificate (PDF), manifest CSV of keys, and a hashed audit file (SHA256).

We can aim for completion within 7 days. I attached a short ops runbook (runbook-omniventure-purge-v1.pdf) that explains the verification steps, rollback controls, and audit capture.

Laura — can you confirm schedule and whether SUP-1029 is sufficient as the execution ticket? Marissa — please advise if the attestation needs additional language.

Elena — once we complete the purge we will send the certificate and manifest via the secure drive link and a signed DocuSign if you require it.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: runbook-omniventure-purge-v1.pdf (pdf)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena@omniventure.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permanent erase of prompt/output logs for CustomerSupportAssistant — schedule and execution details

Hi Elena / Marcus,

Per Marcus' plan, Ops has scheduled the execution window for Thursday May 6 at 02:00 UTC (low-traffic). Notes:
- Execution ticket: SUP-1029 (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-1029)
- Scope: S3 objects under s3://redwood-eu/customer-data/omniventure/customer-support-assistant/*, prompt-log table shards 42-45, and in-memory KV caches for the project.
- Verification: We will capture an object manifest pre-delete (CSV), compute SHA256 for the manifest, perform deletes, then produce a post-delete scan that verifies keys are gone and delete markers are present.
- Preservation: During verification we will place a temporary hold and not overwrite data until attestation is issued.

Attachments: runbook-omniventure-purge-v1.pdf (same as Marcus' attachment)

If OmniVenture wants to observe (read-only) our verification logs, we can grant temporary viewer access to the Drive folder for the artifacts. Please confirm whether you want that.

Laura Bennett
Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena@omniventure.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 02:34:00 +0000
Subject: Execution complete — purge certificate and manifest (OmniVenture)

Elena, Marcus —

Execution summary: purge completed at 02:12 UTC, 2027-05-06. Key points:
- Pre-delete manifest captured (purge_manifest-omniventure-20270505.csv). SHA256(manifest) = c3b6f8d9a1e5f6e2f9b8d7a3c2b1e4f5a6d7c8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e
- Deletions performed for listed S3 objects, prompt-log shards were truncated and evicted from KV cache.
- Post-delete scan confirmed delete markers and no accessible copies for the keys in the manifest.

Artifacts delivered to secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3RunbookOmniV
Attachments included: purge_manifest-omniventure-20270505.csv, purge_certificate-omniventure-20270505.pdf

If you need a DocuSign-signed attestation, Marissa will send that within the next business day.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: purge_certificate-omniventure-20270505.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Soto <elena@omniventure.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permanent erase of prompt/output logs for CustomerSupportAssistant

Marcus / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clear artifacts. I reviewed the manifest and the SHA256 matches what our ingestion team computed. Please have Marissa issue the signed attestation and we'll mark the request closed on our end.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Best,
Elena
Head of Trust & Safety, OmniVenture
